name: skillsafe
description: Scan agent skills for security issues before you install them, and check your own skills before you publish them, with the free SkillSafe scanner.

interface.longDescription:
Third-party agent skills can carry prompt injection, credential theft, data exfiltration, or hidden persistence. SkillSafe scans them before they reach your machine.

This plugin adds two skills:

- scan-before-install: give it a GitHub URL and it runs the free SkillSafe scanner on the skill or plugin there, then reports a grade (A+ to F), the number of findings, and a link to the full report with every finding and a bill of materials (network destinations, environment variables, commands, file access). It only scans; installing stays your decision.
- check-skill-before-publishing: checks a skill you wrote, explains each finding, helps you fix it, and points you to where to publish.

No account or API key is needed. The plugin sends requests only to api.skillsafe.ai: a public GitHub URL for the first skill, and, with your confirmation, the text files of your own skill for the second. Files sent for checking are analyzed and not stored.
defaultPrompt: Is this skill safe to install? https://github.com/OWNER/REPO
Check my skill in ./my-skill before I publish it.
